hero.name: Josue Vargas
hero.title: Senior Software Engineer
hero.subtitle: Technical leadership and software architecture in Fintech and Payments.
hero.description: 6+ years building web and mobile platforms. Technical reference at **Red de Servicios Facilito (Prosegur)**, with 50,000+ payment points in Ecuador: I define **architecture**, review solutions and ship projects to production with **Angular**, **NestJS**, **.NET** and **Azure**.

menudigital.title: MenuDigital.ec
menudigital.description: Digital menu SaaS for restaurants in Ecuador. Monorepo with landing page, admin panel (dashboard, analytics, multi-location, roles) and public menus with 3 templates. WhatsApp orders with no commissions.

ubicanos.title: Ubícanos – Facilito
ubicanos.description: Public payment-point map for Red de Servicios Facilito, Ecuador's payment-collection network with 50,000+ locations. Designed, built and shipped to production.

canal-pagos.title: Canal de Pagos – Facilito
canal-pagos.description: Red de Servicios Facilito's "where and how to pay" portal, with a developer portal for integrators. Designed, built and shipped to production.

directorio-kioscos.title: Touch-Screen Kiosk Directory
directorio-kioscos.description: Interactive directory for a shopping mall's touch-screen kiosks, built end to end.

plataforma-fundacion.title: Foundation Management Platform
plataforma-fundacion.description: End-to-end platform for a scholarship foundation: CMS-driven website, online scholarship calls and applications with socioeconomic assessment, scholar management, activities and volunteering, a portal for students and guardians, online donations (Payphone and Datafast), WhatsApp campaigns, roles, audit logs and KPI reports.

invitacion-boda.title: Digital Wedding Invitation
invitacion-boda.description: Interactive web invitation with background music, countdown, photo gallery, itinerary, gift registry, Google Calendar integration and RSVP form.

licoreria.title: Liquor Store Web System
licoreria.description: Progressive web app (PWA) for inventory management and sales of a liquor store with offline support.

control-lectura.title: Reading Control System
control-lectura.description: Web platform for tracking and managing readings with API documentation and cloud file storage.

app-eventos.title: Events App
app-eventos.description: Mobile application for event management and browsing with authentication and real-time data.

portfolio.title: Portfolio Website
portfolio.description: Professional portfolio with multilingual support, dark/light theme and animations.

exp-1.description: Define architecture and stack for new projects across 30+ repositories, review team solutions and mentor developers. Lead the Departmental Admin platform (Angular + NestJS), the back-office replacing legacy systems with no source code. Shipped Ubícanos and Canal de Pagos to production, designed the Datafast POS integration API (live in 12 branches) and built a centralized identity service (.NET 7, Microsoft Entra ID + LDAP). Automated bank reconciliation with an RPA bot (Node.js, Playwright) and implemented CI/CD with Azure DevOps, Docker and Azure Container Apps, migrating on-premise services to the cloud.

exp-2.description: Full stack development of Onboarding, Payments Portal and Facilito Web (Angular, .NET, NestJS, SQL Server). Cut merchant onboarding from 2 hours to 15 minutes. Contributed to migrating Facilito Web to Angular + .NET, making it 30% faster, and optimized critical reports from 10 min to 1 min. Implemented CI/CD pipelines reducing deployments from 1 hour to 10 minutes and integrated Western Union remittance payouts (CISLATAM).

exp-3.description: Taught mobile development with Ionic and Angular, with a hands-on, project-based approach and personalized code reviews.

exp-4.description: Developed the internal credit application and member enrollment system. Contributed to the institutional mobile app (Flutter), reducing member enrollment from 3-4 hours to 20 minutes. Built the internal web approval flow and supported mobile credit requests, cutting processing from 6 hours to 1 hour. Created CI/CD pipelines and documented APIs with Swagger.

exp-5.description: Participated in developing the TendaGo mobile app in Flutter and the Service Broker web admin. Designed mobile interface prototypes in Figma for client presentations.

exp-6.description: End-to-end systems and apps for businesses: an interactive directory for a shopping mall's touch-screen kiosks (React + NestJS) and a scholarship management platform for a foundation (Next.js + Prisma).

edu-1.description: Dual international degree. IT Project Management, Big Data, Information Security and Strategic Planning.
